title: Beat Lanes
description: Glowing notes slide down the lanes. Tap each lane right when its note reaches the line, hold the long ones, and build a big combo! Play nine songs from Twinkle Twinkle to the Can-Can, fill the Groove meter for Star Power, and unlock new songs with stars.
notes: Original note-highway rhythm game (no brand names or layouts copied), built on the Oomba Kit (pinned kit tag plus the art-animals, art-biomes, art-biomes-2, art-props and dress packs): each song plays in its own kit world at dusk or night (space, jungle, meadow, city, castle, beach, candy, spooky, desert) with a band beside the far end of the lanes, the player's own avatar (Oomba.avatar(), the mascot for guests) and three kit friends in headphones under spotlights, bobbing to the beat and cheering on combos, Star Power and a cleared song, plus a kit crowd on wide screens; the kit's title, pause and settings screens, the kit font, icons and colours, and the game's song list, levels, results and calibration as cards in the kit's look. A perspective highway in the Oomba Ink style (Ink outlines, the classic lane order red, yellow, blue, green in kit hues on a deep night-blue road, pale-gold Star Power gems; on tall phones the band stands beside the lanes and, outside a song, beside a narrower highway and under the results card) with gem notes, 3 lanes on Easy and 4 on Normal/Hard, big tap pads, multi-touch for two-lane chords, keys D F J K / arrows / 1-4, Space for Star Power, P/Esc pause, M mute. All music is synthesised live with WebAudio (melody synths, bass, pads, kick/snare/hat from noise, a hit pluck, crowd cheer); no audio files. The AudioContext clock is the master clock: a 25 ms look-ahead scheduler queues music 120 ms ahead and the picture follows the audio actually being heard (getOutputTimestamp, or currentTime minus output latency); taps are judged from their own event timestamps. Songs: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star, Row Row Row Your Boat, Frère Jacques (both as rounds), Ode to Joy (Beethoven), Can-Can (Offenbach), In the Hall of the Mountain King (Grieg, speeds up 76 to 170 BPM), William Tell gallop (Rossini), plus two originals, Robot Groove and Lo-Fi Lagoon. Each song is one hand-written chart (melody with chord/hold/ghost/accent flags) turned into Easy/Normal/Hard by a generator: strongest beats first, minimum gaps per level, holds from long notes, chords on Hard only, quick repeats alternate lanes. Judging: Perfect 45 ms, Great 90 ms, Good 140 ms (Easy x1.35), early/late shown; empty taps cost combo on Hard only. Combo multiplier x2/x3/x4 at 10/20/30, Groove meter and 8 s Star Power (double points), health on Normal/Hard with a gentle 'Let's try again', Easy and Practice never fail, Practice can slow songs to 75%. Calibration screen (tap to the beat, 8 taps) plus a +/-200 ms offset slider, applied to judging and to the note picture. Grades S/A/B/C, Full Combo, All Perfect; 1-3 stars per level unlock 5 more songs. Saves best score/grade per song and level, the offset and note speed in BRB.storage key 'beat-lanes-v1' (ids only). Leaderboard: Normal/Hard only, BRB.score.submit(score, 'points') then BRB.gameOver({won, score}); Easy and Practice call BRB.gameOver({won: true}). No strobing (beat pulses are slow fades, at most one per beat and every other beat above 150 BPM); reduced motion (the kit's setting) calms the stage and removes shake and bobbing. Speaks all 13 site languages (I18N table, BRB.user.lang, RTL menus for he/ar with the highway kept left to right). window.__brbTest drives the game for tests.

pt.description: Notas brilhantes deslizam pelas pistas. Toque cada pista bem quando a nota chegar na linha, segure as notas longas e faça um combo enorme! Jogue nove músicas, de Brilha, brilha, estrelinha ao Can-can, encha o medidor de ritmo para usar o Poder Estrela e libere novas músicas com estrelas.

fr.description: Des notes brillantes glissent sur les pistes. Tape chaque piste pile quand sa note touche la ligne, garde le doigt sur les notes longues et fais un énorme combo ! Joue neuf chansons, d’Ah ! vous dirai-je, maman au French cancan, remplis la jauge Groove pour le Pouvoir Étoile et débloque de nouvelles chansons avec des étoiles.

es.description: Notas brillantes bajan por los carriles. Toca cada carril justo cuando su nota llegue a la línea, mantén las notas largas y haz un combo enorme. Juega nueve canciones, de Estrellita, ¿dónde estás? al Cancán, llena el medidor de ritmo para el poder estelar y desbloquea canciones nuevas con estrellas.

de.description: Leuchtende Noten rutschen die Spuren herunter. Tippe jede Spur genau dann, wenn ihre Note die Linie erreicht, halte die langen Noten und bau eine riesige Combo! Spiel neun Lieder von Funkel, funkel, kleiner Stern bis zum Cancan, füll die Groove-Leiste für Sternkraft und schalte mit Sternen neue Lieder frei.

he.description: תווים זוהרים מחליקים במסלולים. הקישו על כל מסלול בדיוק כשהתו שלו מגיע לקו, החזיקו את התווים הארוכים ובנו קומבו ענק! שחקו תשעה שירים, מנצנץ, נצנץ, כוכב קטן ועד הקנקן, מלאו את מד הגרוב בשביל כוח כוכב ופתחו שירים חדשים עם כוכבים.

ja.description: キラキラのノートがレーンをすべりおりてくるよ。ノートがラインにきたら、そのレーンをタップ！ながいノートはおしたまま。コンボをつなげよう！きらきらぼしからてんごくとじごくまで9きょくであそべます。グルーヴをためてスターパワー、ほしをあつめてあたらしいきょくをひらこう。
ja.tags: おんがく,リズム,ビート,タップ,うた,タイミング,ピアノ,ドラム,アーケード,ダンス,クラシック

ar.description: نغمات لامعة تنزلق في المسارات. اضغط على كل مسار عندما تصل نغمته إلى الخط تمامًا، واضغط مطولًا على النغمات الطويلة، واصنع سلسلة كبيرة! العب تسع أغانٍ من تلألئي يا نجمة صغيرة إلى الكانكان، واملأ مقياس الإيقاع لتشغيل قوة النجمة، وافتح أغاني جديدة بالنجوم.

ru.description: Светящиеся ноты скользят по дорожкам. Нажимай на дорожку ровно тогда, когда нота дойдёт до линии, держи долгие ноты и собирай огромное комбо! Девять песен — от «Мерцай, мерцай, звёздочка» до «Канкана». Наполни шкалу грува для звёздной силы и открывай новые песни за звёзды.

it.description: Note luminose scivolano lungo le corsie. Tocca ogni corsia proprio quando la sua nota arriva alla linea, tieni premute le note lunghe e fai una combo enorme! Gioca nove canzoni, da Brilla brilla la stellina al Can-can, riempi la barra del ritmo per il Potere Stella e sblocca nuove canzoni con le stelle.

zh-Hant.description: 閃亮的音符從跑道滑下來。音符碰到線的那一刻點下那條跑道，長音符要按住，打出超長連擊！從小星星到康康舞曲共有九首歌。集滿律動條就能用星星力量，收集星星還能解鎖新歌。
zh-Hant.tags: 音樂,節奏,節拍,點擊,歌曲,時機,鋼琴,鼓,街機,跳舞,古典

nl.description: Glimmende noten glijden over de banen. Tik op elke baan precies als de noot de lijn raakt, houd de lange noten vast en maak een megacombo! Speel negen liedjes, van Twinkel, twinkel, kleine ster tot de Cancan, vul de groovemeter voor Sterrenkracht en speel nieuwe liedjes vrij met sterren.
